description: Defines the ConfigStructure class which manages configuration data structures, including fields, size calculations, and code generation for C headers, TunerStudio, and Java fields.

classes.name: ConfigStructure
classes.description: Represents a configuration data structure with methods for size calculation, code generation, and field management.

methods.name: addAlignmentFill
methods.description: Adds padding to align the structure size to 4 bytes based on current fields.

methods.name: headerWrite
methods.description: Generates a C header struct definition for the configuration structure.

methods.name: writeTunerStudio
methods.description: Writes TunerStudio configuration fields to a header file.

methods.name: writeJavaFields
methods.description: Writes Java field definitions for the configuration structure.

methods.name: addBoth
methods.description: Adds a ConfigField to both C and TS field lists.

methods.name: addC
methods.description: Adds a ConfigField to the C fields list.

methods.name: addTs
methods.description: Adds a ConfigField to the TunerStudio fields list.
